pipelines.empty: The daemon advertises no dictation modes.
pipelines.awaitingModel: The speech model is not installed. Install the bundled model to enable dictation.
pipelines.unavailable: No dictation mode is currently available.
pipelines.selectionChanged: The previous mode is unavailable. Selected mode is now {id}. Start again to dictate with it.
pipelines.selectionRemoved: The previous mode is unavailable and no replacement is enabled. Choose an available mode to continue.
status.provisionStalled: The model installation did not report completion within the expected time. Retry to refresh daemon status.
dictation.noStartablePipeline: No dictation mode is enabled. Install the speech model, then retry.
dictation.recoveryResultUnverified: The completed result could not be verified. Open Diagnostics for details.
dictation.hint: Start captures audio, Stop finalizes, Cancel aborts.
dictation.captureLimit: Recording stops automatically at {seconds} s (daemon-reported limit).
dictation.captureLimitDeveloper: Developer probe window {seconds} s; the documented maximum stays {max} s.
dictation.endSafetyLimit: Recording reached the {seconds} s capture limit. Everything captured before the limit was transcribed.
dictation.endSafetyLimitUnknown: Recording reached the daemon's capture limit. Everything captured before the limit was transcribed.
dictation.endSourceEnded: The microphone disconnected before you stopped. What you had said is saved in History, not typed into the app (less than half a second is not kept).
models.testLaneBody: Returns a fixed sentence without listening. Used for development and smoke tests.

setup.title: Set up speech recognition
setup.body: Narrivy comes with {name}, an English model of {size}. Setting it up copies it into place on this computer; nothing is downloaded.
setup.bodyGeneric: Narrivy comes with a small English speech model. Setting it up copies it into place on this computer; nothing is downloaded.
setup.cancelled: Setup was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
setup.failedGeneric: Setup did not finish. Try again, or see Diagnostics.
models.notYetHint: In the catalog, but no checked download is published yet.
models.installBody: Install the verified model included with Narrivy. No network connection is used.
models.installFailure.source_rejected: The bundled model file failed its checks (owner, permissions or size). Reinstall the Narrivy package.
models.installFailure.import_failed: The model could not be copied into Narrivy's model folder. Check free disk space, then try again.
models.installFailure.cleanup_failed: A partly copied model could not be removed. Restart Narrivy, then try again.
models.installFailure.published_unconfir: The model was copied but could not be confirmed. Restart Narrivy.
models.installFailure.binding_failed: The copied model did not match its expected identity. Try again.
models.installFailure.activation_failed: The speech engine could not start with this model. See Diagnostics.
models.installFailure.shutting_down: Narrivy was stopping. Try again once it is running.
models.installFailure.worker_failed: The speech engine stopped while loading the model. See Diagnostics.
models.installFailure.other: The model could not be installed ({code}).
models.noLane: No ASR capability is reported by the daemon.
history.disabled: History is unavailable and remains off. Temporary recovery data may be retained briefly to protect an in-progress delivery; it is not shown as History.
history.noText: This entry has no delivered text.
settings.recognition.title: Recognition
settings.recognition.description: Spoken language, written language, script, translation, locale, and context hints advertised by the loaded model.
settings.recognition.unavailable: Recognition settings are unavailable for the loaded model.
settings.recognition.contextHintsHelp: Optional words or phrases, separated by commas or new lines.
settings.recognition.contextUnavailable: Context bias is unavailable for the loaded model.
settings.compute.title: Compute
settings.compute.description: The daemon resolves compute from the capabilities it advertises. Narrivy has no command to change it.
settings.compute.deviceUnavailable: The daemon resolves the compute device from the capabilities it advertises, and advertises no device priority or fallback order. Narrivy has no command to change it.
settings.compute.noCapabilitiesReported: The daemon reports no capability in this group.
settings.compute.autoFallback: Automatically fall back if device fails
settings.compute.controlUnavailable: Unavailable: the daemon reports {reported} and exposes no command to change it.
settings.compute.controlNoCapability: Unavailable: the daemon reports no capability for this setting and exposes no command to change it.
settings.delivery.title: Text Delivery
settings.delivery.description: The daemon chooses the delivery lane and reports the rungs it can use. Narrivy has no command to change it, so no method list or fallback chain is claimed here.
settings.delivery.laneUnavailable: The daemon selects the delivery lane from its own policy. Narrivy has no command to change it.
settings.delivery.reportedCapabilities: Delivery capabilities reported by the daemon
settings.delivery.perAppUnavailable: Not implemented. The daemon advertises no per-application capability, so no application is listed and no override can be added.
settings.automation.title: Automation
settings.automation.description: The daemon decides how it is driven and reports its policy. Narrivy has no command to change it.
settings.automation.reportedCapabilities: Automation capabilities reported by the daemon
settings.pipelines.title: Import and export
settings.pipelines.plannedTitle: Planned after 1.0. Narrivy uses only its built-in pipelines for now, so import and export are off.

about.blurb: Private, local-first dictation. Speak anywhere on your desktop; your voice never leaves this computer.
palette.title: Command palette
onboard.title: Getting started
onboard.welcome.title: Welcome to Narrivy
onboard.welcome.body: Three quick steps: check your microphone, run one dictation, then you are set.
onboard.mic.title: Check your microphone
onboard.mic.body: Runs one isolated capability check against the daemon.
settings.portal.title: Direct text delivery permission
settings.portal.body: Your desktop may ask for keyboard-only permission so Narrivy can type the final transcript into the active app. Permission alone does not guarantee delivery support.
settings.portal.unavailable: Direct text delivery permission is unavailable in this desktop session.
settings.portal.permission_active: Keyboard permission is active. Direct delivery remains unqualified until Diagnostics confirms it.
settings.portal.permission_inactive: Text delivery permission was not granted.
settings.portal.parent_export_failed: The desktop could not attach the permission prompt to this window.
settings.portal.cleanup_unconfirmed: Permission cleanup could not be confirmed. Restart Narrivy before trying again.
onboard.dictation.title: First dictation
onboard.dictation.body: Start once, stop once. Nothing leaves this machine.
onboard.shortcut.title: Global activation
onboard.shortcut.body: Narrivy only changes the desktop shortcuts you set in Narrivy. Set one later under Pipelines by pressing the keys you want, or add this exact command in your desktop's own keyboard shortcut settings:
onboard.shortcut.notConfigured: This command is a suggestion only. Narrivy has not configured the shortcut and cannot confirm it works until a later check observes it.
onboard.shortcut.setBody: Pick the keys that start and stop dictation in any app. You can change them later under Pipelines.
onboard.shortcut.saved: Shortcut set. Press it in any app to dictate.
onboard.shortcut.listenerReady: A live shortcut listener is active; no manual command is needed.
home.sub.ready: Dictate in any app. Narrivy types where your cursor is.
home.sub.live: Speak naturally, then stop to insert the text
home.sub.busy: Turning your speech into text on this computer
home.sub.blocked: Narrivy needs attention before it can listen.
home.transcript.empty: Your words will appear here as you speak.
history.lead: Your recent dictations, kept on this device.
diag.lead: Run a check to see whether each part of dictation works on this computer.
about.privacyBody: Local only. No account, no cloud.
settings.lead: Choices are saved on this computer. Automatic values show what Narrivy resolved.
about.updatesBody: Narrivy never goes online on its own. Updates arrive through your package manager.
about.updatesHowTo: To update now, run this in a terminal:
about.checkUpdatesComing: A manual, opt-in check is planned. It needs your permission to go online, which you will grant in Settings → Privacy.
version.label: Version {version}
fm.general.title: General
fm.general.startAtLogin.title: Start Narrivy at login
fm.general.startAtLogin.desc: Off by default. When on, the service and tray start with your session.
fm.general.startHidden.title: Start hidden in the tray
fm.general.startHidden.desc: Open only the tray icon at login, without the window.
fm.general.closeToTray.title: Closing the window keeps Narrivy running
fm.general.closeToTray.desc: Dictation keeps working from the tray. Quit from the tray menu.
fm.general.uiLanguage.title: Interface language
fm.general.uiLanguage.desc: More languages will follow the English release.
fm.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
fm.shortcuts.desc: Start and stop dictation from anywhere on your desktop.
fm.shortcuts.toggle.title: Toggle dictation
fm.shortcuts.toggle.desc: Add this command to your desktop's keyboard shortcut settings. Narrivy never changes your shortcuts itself.
fm.shortcuts.hold.title: Press and hold to talk
fm.shortcuts.hold.desc: Hold a key while you speak; release to insert the text.
fm.shortcuts.cancel.title: Cancel dictation
fm.shortcuts.cancel.desc: Discard the current dictation without inserting anything.
fm.shortcuts.desktopShortcuts.title: Desktop shortcut service
fm.shortcuts.desktopShortcuts.desc: Whether your desktop offers shortcuts Narrivy can register directly.
fm.microphone.title: Microphone
fm.microphone.desc: Which input Narrivy listens to, and for how long.
echo.title: Ignore this computer's sound
echo.desc: Removes what your speakers play (a video, people on a call) from the microphone, so only voices in the room are written down. Not needed with headphones.
echo.off: Off: the microphone hears everything, the speakers included.
echo.unavailable: Not available: the Narrivy service is not running or needs updating.
voice.title: Only my voice
voice.desc: Train Narrivy on your voice once, and dictation keeps only what you say: people talking near you are left out. Narrivy keeps a fingerprint of your voice on this computer, not a recording.
voice.untrained: Not trained yet. Training takes 20 seconds of reading aloud.
voice.active: On: only your voice is written down.
voice.off: Off: everyone the microphone hears is written down.
voice.unavailable: Not available: the voice filter is not installed, or the Narrivy service needs updating.
voice.reading: Read this aloud in your normal voice… {seconds} s
voice.passage: I'm setting up Narrivy so it knows my voice. When I dictate a message, an email or a note, it should write down what I say and leave out anyone else in the room. I speak English and Urdu, sometimes in the same sentence. Today is a good day to try something new, so let's see how well this works.
voice.passageUrdu: میں اردو میں بھی بات کرتا ہوں، اور یہ میری آواز ہے۔
voice.failed.short: Not enough speech was heard. Train again and read the whole passage aloud.
voice.failed.other: Training did not finish ({code}). Try again.
fm.microphone.device.title: Input device
fm.microphone.device.desc: Choose a microphone instead of the system default.
fm.microphone.capture.title: Capture
fm.microphone.capture.desc: Whether the service can record from your microphone.
fm.microphone.maxLength.title: Longest dictation
fm.microphone.maxLength.desc: Recording stops automatically at this limit.
fm.microphone.autoStop.title: Stop when you stop talking
fm.microphone.autoStop.desc: A pause never ends a dictation. It ends when you stop it, or at the length limit.
fm.microphone.otherAudio.title: Other audio
fm.microphone.otherAudio.desc: Music and calls keep playing while you dictate.
fm.microphone.sounds.title: Start and stop sounds
fm.microphone.sounds.desc: Play a short sound when listening starts and ends.
fm.speech.title: Speech model
fm.speech.desc: The model that turns speech into text, and how it writes.
fm.speech.model.title: Model
fm.speech.model.desc: Pick a model size, or let Narrivy choose the best one for this computer.
fm.speech.installed.title: Installed model
fm.speech.installed.desc: The model the service has ready right now.
fm.speech.languages.title: Languages
fm.speech.detectLanguage.title: Detect language automatically
fm.speech.detectLanguage.desc: Recognise which language you are speaking.
fm.speech.liveText.title: Text while speaking
fm.speech.liveText.desc: Whether words appear during dictation or after you stop.
fm.speech.numbers.title: Write numbers as digits
fm.speech.numbers.desc: Turn “twenty five” into “25” where it makes sense. Off by default.
fm.speech.numbersPerModel.title: Numbers for this model
fm.speech.numbersPerModel.desc: Override the global choice for a model that already writes digits.
fm.compute.title: Compute
fm.compute.desc: Where recognition runs on this computer.
fm.compute.ladder.title: Selected device
fm.compute.ladder.desc: Narrivy prefers an NPU, then a GPU, and uses the CPU as a last resort.
fm.compute.gpu.title: Use the GPU
fm.compute.gpu.desc: Recognition already runs on your graphics processor when it passes a self-test. This switch will let you turn that off.
fm.compute.npu.title: Use the NPU
fm.compute.npu.desc: Run recognition on your neural processor when it is qualified.
fm.modes.title: Modes and words
fm.modes.desc: How your words are cleaned up before they are inserted.
fm.modes.available.title: Available modes
fm.modes.available.desc: Clean tidies punctuation and capitals; Raw inserts exactly what was heard.
fm.modes.aliases.title: Spoken shortcuts
fm.modes.aliases.desc: Say a phrase and insert your own text, such as an email signature.
fm.modes.vocabulary.title: Custom words
fm.modes.vocabulary.desc: Names and terms the model should recognise, and replacements. Set them in Pipelines, in the Transcribe stage.
fm.modes.punctuation.title: Spoken punctuation
fm.modes.punctuation.desc: Say “comma” or “new line” to insert them.
fm.insertion.title: Text insertion
fm.insertion.desc: How finished text reaches the app you are typing in.
fm.insertion.method.title: Insertion method
fm.insertion.method.desc: Automatic types the text, and falls back to the Inbox if typing fails.
fm.insertion.typing.title: Typing
fm.insertion.typing.desc: Whether the service can type into the focused app.
fm.insertion.inbox.title: Inbox backup
fm.insertion.inbox.desc: Typed text cannot be confirmed, so each dictation also gets a private copy in the Inbox (only your account can read it), kept for 15 minutes and cleared when you log out. History keeps the lasting copy, if History is on.
fm.insertion.paste.title: Paste instead of typing
fm.insertion.paste.desc: Insert through the clipboard. Faster for long text.
fm.insertion.restoreClipboard.title: Restore the clipboard
fm.insertion.restoreClipboard.desc: Put back whatever you had copied after pasting.
fm.insertion.trailingSpace.title: Add a space after text
fm.insertion.trailingSpace.desc: Makes consecutive dictations flow as one sentence.
fm.overlay.title: Overlay
fm.overlay.desc: The small indicator shown while you dictate.
fm.overlay.focus.title: Takes keyboard focus
fm.overlay.focus.desc: The overlay can never steal focus from the app you are typing in.
fm.overlay.show.title: Show the overlay
fm.overlay.show.desc: Show listening and processing status while you dictate.
overlayPosition.title: Position
overlayPosition.desc: Where the overlay appears on the screen while you dictate.
fm.overlay.monitor.title: Screen
fm.overlay.monitor.desc: The overlay follows the screen your pointer is on.
fm.history.title: History
fm.history.desc: What Narrivy remembers after a dictation.
fm.history.enabled.title: History
fm.history.enabled.desc: Keep past dictations on this computer.
fm.history.keep.title: Entries to keep
fm.history.currentLimit.title: Current limit
fm.history.clear.title: Clear history
fm.history.clear.desc: Delete every saved dictation from this computer.
fm.privacy.title: Privacy
fm.privacy.localOnly.title: Local processing only
fm.privacy.localOnly.desc: Audio and text never leave this computer.
fm.privacy.recovery.title: Crash recovery
fm.privacy.recovery.desc: The text of each dictation is kept for 15 minutes in a private recovery journal and the Inbox, so a crash or a failed paste cannot lose it.
fm.privacy.logs.title: Logs
fm.privacy.logs.desc: Logs never contain your audio or your words.
fm.advanced.title: Advanced
fm.advanced.service.title: Service version
fm.advanced.service.desc: The Narrivy service this window is connected to.
fm.advanced.supportReport.title: Support report
fm.advanced.supportReport.desc: A report for troubleshooting that contains no audio or text.
fm.advanced.logLevel.title: Log detail
fm.advanced.logLevel.desc: How much the service writes to its logs.
fm.status.plannedTitle: Decided and scheduled in completion-plan task {task}; not connected yet.
fm.status.proposedTitle: Suggested for parity with other dictation apps; waiting for an owner decision.
fm.legend: Live settings work now. Items marked Coming are decided and scheduled; their controls unlock when the service supports them.

home.transcript.emptyOverview: Nothing dictated yet. Dictate in any app and the latest text appears here.
strip.label: Live status
strip.plannedNotUsed: The compute planner chose the {planned}, but recognition does not run there yet.
strip.ramTitle: Memory used by the Narrivy service ({count} processes)
strip.gpuTitle: How hard this computer's GPU works (all apps), over the last 10 minutes
strip.gpuTitleOwn: How hard this computer's GPU works (all apps), over the last 10 minutes. Narrivy's part now: {own}
strip.npuTitle: How busy this computer's NPU is (everything using it), over the last 10 minutes
assistant.activity.empty: What the assistant does shows here as it works: what it reads, its thinking, each tool call and the answer.
strip.cpuTitle: Share of this computer's CPU used by the Narrivy service, over the last 10 minutes
strip.latencyTitle: Typical time from stopping to text (slowest 5%: {p95})
home.sub.private: Your voice stays on this device.
home.stage.cleanDetail: Audio is transcribed as captured. Noise suppression is not part of this release.
home.pasteAgainComing: Insert the last text again into the focused app. Scheduled; not connected yet.
home.privacyTitle: Your voice stays on this device
home.privacyBody: Processing, models and data never leave your computer.
home.tip.toggle: Start/stop dictation from any app (bind it to a key)
home.tip.tray: Start, stop or open Narrivy from the tray
dictationPage.mode.clean: Tidies punctuation, capitals and spacing before inserting.
dictationPage.mode.raw: Inserts exactly what the model heard.
pipelinesPage.lead: A pipeline is the path from your microphone to inserted text. Pick the one Narrivy uses.
apps.lead: Give individual applications their own insertion method, mode or vocabulary.
apps.title: No application rules yet
apps.body: Every application uses your global settings. Per-application rules are planned after the 1.0 release.
apps.planned.insertion.title: Insertion method per app
apps.planned.insertion.body: For example, paste into terminals and type everywhere else.
apps.planned.mode.title: Mode per app
apps.planned.mode.body: Use Raw for code editors and Clean for email and chat.
apps.planned.vocabulary.title: Vocabulary per app
apps.planned.vocabulary.body: Prefer project names and terms in the apps where you use them.
ladder.priority.title: Automatic priority
ladder.priority.desc: Narrivy tries each device in this order and uses the first one qualified on this computer.
ladder.chain.title: Fallback chain
ladder.chain.desc: Narrivy tries each method in order until the text lands. If typing fails, the Inbox keeps a copy.
home.tip.escape: Close a dialog or this panel
home.fact.inboxBackup: Inbox keeps the text if typing fails
home.latency.caption: Typical time from stop to inserted text
home.resources.title: Resources
home.resources.caption: Service and {count} processes
home.resources.unreported: The service does not report resource use yet.
home.services.title: Services
recent.title: Recent
recent.historyOff: History is off, so nothing is kept after a dictation.
recent.empty: Your dictations will be listed here.
recent.noText: No text was kept for this dictation
recent.retryComing: Insert this text again. Not connected yet.
recent.deleteUnsupported: This Narrivy service cannot delete entries yet; update it.
accent.label: Accent colour
greeting.label: Show greeting
greeting.hint: The time-of-day greeting at the top of Home.
pipe.lead: Each pipeline takes your voice from the microphone to text in an app. Click a stage to see and change its options; drag to reorder, click a name to rename.
pipe.footnote: Order and names are saved on this computer; shortcuts are saved in your desktop's keyboard settings. Live works now, From service is read from Narrivy, Coming is scheduled, and Proposed waits for a decision.
pipe.renameHint: Click to rename. Clear the name to go back to the original.
pipe.mic.chooseHint: Pick a specific input device for this pipeline.
pipe.mic.gainHint: Evens out quiet and loud speech.
pipe.mic.echoHint: Removes sound from your speakers while you dictate.
pipe.noise.suppressionHint: Removes background noise before transcription. Audio is used as captured today.
pipe.noise.suppressionLive: Removes steady background noise (fans, hum, traffic) along with the computer's sound. Strong removes more, but can make quiet speech thinner.
pipe.noise.suppressionNeedsEcho: Works together with “Ignore this computer's sound”: turn that on to choose a level.
pipe.noise.vadHint: Notices when you are speaking. Not used: nothing depends on it today.
pipe.noise.endpointHint: A pause never ends a dictation. It ends when you stop it, or at the length limit.
pipe.model.chooseHint: The downloaded model that transcribes speech for {pipeline}. Each pipeline keeps its own; switching pipelines reloads only when the model or device differs.
pipe.model.accelHint: Where this pipeline runs its model. Automatic uses a graphics processor when it passes a self-test, and the CPU otherwise.
pipe.model.loadedTitle: This model is in memory now
pipe.model.npuNote: needs an NPU model from the Store
pipe.model.noneListed: The service did not list any downloaded model.
pipe.model.failed: That model could not be loaded ({reason}). The previous model is still in use.
pipe.lang.title: Languages
pipe.lang.hint: The language you speak and the language to write. These apply whenever you start dictation from this app.
pipe.lang.shortcutsHint: Keys that start this pipeline in other languages than the one chosen above. You do not need them: the tray's Language menu switches too.
pipe.lang.currentHint: What dictation writes in, for every pipeline. Start, your usual shortcut and press and hold use it. You can also switch it from the tray's Language menu.
pipe.lang.noLanguages: Add the languages you dictate in; they show here and in the tray.
pipe.lang.oneLanguage: The installed model reports one language. Install a multilingual model for more choices.
pipe.refine.hintsHint: Words that help the model recognise names and terms. Set them under Transcribe → Languages.
pipe.refine.guardLive: Keeps the rules-only text when the model answers instead of cleaning up, adds words you did not say, or drops most of what you said.
pipe.refine.cleanupModelHint: Removes fillers and false starts and fixes grammar in each dictation of the Clean pipeline. Choose the model in Models → Correction.
pipe.deliver.methodHint: Type the text, paste it, or keep it in the Inbox.
pipe.deliver.restoreHint: Puts back what you had copied after pasting.
pipe.deliver.inboxHint: Keeps the text if it cannot be typed into the app.
pipe.deliver.verifiedHint: Checks the app actually received the text.
pipe.deliver.spaceHint: Adds a trailing space so the next dictation does not run on.
pipe.shortcut.title: Shortcuts
pipe.shortcut.hint: Start and stop dictation with this pipeline from anywhere.
pipe.shortcut.manual: Or add it yourself in your desktop's keyboard settings
pipe.shortcut.manualOnly: Narrivy cannot add shortcuts on this desktop yet. Add this command in your desktop's keyboard settings.
capture.title: Shortcut for {name}
capture.prompt: Press the keys you want to use.
capture.hint: Use one key or several: a function key, Pause or Insert on its own, Ctrl, Alt, Super or Shift on their own (they run when released), or any of them with another key. Keys your desktop already uses may not reach this window. Esc cancels.
capture.invalid: That key types text, so it would stop working everywhere else. Add Ctrl, Alt or Super, or pick a key that types nothing, such as F9 or Pause.
capture.unsupported: Narrivy could not save the shortcut in your desktop's settings. Add the command yourself instead.
capture.conflictShortcut: These keys already run {name}. Pick other keys, or replace that shortcut. It comes back if you later remove this one.
capture.conflictDesktop: Your desktop uses these keys for {name}. Pick other keys, or replace it. The desktop's shortcut returns if you later remove this one.
history.transcribedTitle: Time from when you stopped speaking to the transcribed text
lm.lead.speech: Speech models turn your voice into text, entirely on this computer. One model is in use at a time.
lm.lead.correction: The language model that polishes every dictation: fillers, corrections, punctuation and numbers.
lm.lead.language: The language model the Assistant answers with, and every language model on this computer.
lm.lead.voice: The voices voice mode reads the Assistant's replies with, on this computer.
tts.voicesHint: Spoken on this computer; nothing is sent anywhere
tts.more: Choose the English voice in the Assistant's voice mode.
tts.unavailable: The Narrivy service did not answer. Try again in a moment.
lm.role.clean_upHint: Polishes every dictation: fillers, corrections, punctuation, numbers.
lm.role.assistantHint: Answers in the Assistant screen. Loaded when used.
lm.onComputerHint: Language models run here; nothing is sent anywhere.
lm.empty: Language models will be downloaded here. Until then, clean-up uses the rules only.
lm.more: More language models will be offered for download here.
lm.unavailable: The Narrivy service is too old or not running.
assistant.lead: Ask anything. The model runs on this computer, and nothing you ask leaves it.
assistant.emptyNote: Draft an email, explain an error, summarise notes. Dictate into the box with your shortcut, or type.
assistant.placeholder: Ask anything… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
assistant.privacy: Runs locally. Chats are saved on this computer only; delete them any time.
assistant.unloadHint: Free the memory the model uses. Your next question loads it again.
assistant.error.notConfigured: No assistant model is set up yet. It will be added from Models → Language models.
assistant.error.olderService: The Narrivy service is too old for the assistant. Update Narrivy.
assistant.error.timeout: The assistant stopped responding. Try again.
refine.rules.title: Rules
refine.rules.lead: Always on this computer, always the same result for the same words.
refine.rule.spacingHint: Collapses repeated spaces and removes a space before punctuation.
refine.rule.punctuationHint: Adds the missing space after a comma, full stop, colon or question mark.
refine.rule.capitalsHint: Capitalises the first word and the start of each sentence.
refine.rule.endingHint: Ends the text with a full stop when it has no closing punctuation.
refine.rules.perRule: Turn rules on or off one by one
refine.rules.perRuleHint: Choose which rules each pipeline applies.
refine.model.title: Language model
refine.model.lead: Optional. A small model on this computer that improves wording beyond what rules can do.
refine.model.whereHint: Auto picks the fastest device proven on this computer, sharing it with transcription only when that is quicker.
refine.level.title: How far it may change your text
refine.level.hint: A stricter level keeps closer to what you said.
refine.privacyHint: The language model runs on this computer. A cloud option may follow later as a separate, clearly marked choice.
models.onComputerHint: The model in use, and others already here.
models.availableHint: Published for Narrivy with a checked size and checksum. Downloading is the only time Narrivy uses the internet, and only when you ask.
models.needsEngineHint: Published, but they need an add-on runtime from the Store.
models.notDownloadableTitle: No download with a checked size and checksum is published for this model yet.
models.downloadFailed: The last download did not finish: {reason}. Whatever arrived is kept, so trying again continues it.
models.downloadReason.tls_failed: a secure connection could not be made
models.downloadReason.redirect_refused: the server sent it somewhere Narrivy does not download from
models.downloadReason.integrity_mismatch: the file did not match its checksum, so it was deleted
models.downloadReason.too_large: the file was larger than published
models.downloadReason.disk_write_failed: it could not be saved on this computer
models.downloadReason.downloader_unavail: the system download tool (curl) is not installed
models.downloadReason.models_directory_u: the models folder can be changed by other users
models.qualifiedTitle: Qualified means this exact model passed Narrivy's checks. Others may work but have not been through them.
models.quantTitle: Quantization: how the model's numbers are compressed. Fewer bits is smaller and faster, slightly less accurate.
models.devicesTitle: Devices this model can be set up for. A device is used only after it passes Narrivy's checks on this computer.
models.sort.name: Name
models.noMatch: Try a different search or clear the filters.
store.lead: Add accelerators and modules to Narrivy. Only what fits this computer can be installed.
store.trust: Narrivy Verified: every file is checked against its published checksum before it is used, and nothing is downloaded unless you ask.
store.modelsElsewhere: Speech models are on the Models screen
store.noResults: Nothing in the store matches that search.
store.acceleratorsHint: Run speech and language models on your NPU or graphics card
store.refineHint: Small language specialists that polish what you dictate
store.extensionsHint: Narrivy in other apps, and whole new areas
store.about.writing-assistant-browser: Checks, fixes and rewrites what you type in Chrome and Brave, using the grammar checker and the language model on this computer.
store.about.ai-assistant: Chat and research with a language model on this computer, with tools and optional web research that cites its sources.
store.about.meeting-transcription: Transcribes your microphone and the other people's audio together, then saves the meeting as a note with a summary.
store.about.voice-changer: Changes your voice live and offers it as a microphone any app can use, such as calls and games.
store.fit.reason.nvidia_found: Fits this computer: an NVIDIA GPU was found
store.fit.reason.no_nvidia: No NVIDIA GPU found on this computer
store.about.vulkan: Included with Narrivy: runs speech models on any graphics card with Vulkan, from Intel, AMD or NVIDIA. Nothing to install.
store.about.openvino: Intel's runtime for the NPU, Intel graphics and the processor. The OpenVINO speech models on the Models screen need it.
store.about.agent_browser: A browser of the assistant's own (Chromium, out of sight, with a fresh profile each time). It opens the pages it makes or finds and checks how they look and their errors. Without it the assistant uses Firefox, if installed.
store.about.cuda: NVIDIA's runtime, for the fastest recognition on GeForce and RTX graphics cards.
store.about.refine-llm-openvino: Fixes grammar, punctuation and wording after you dictate, using a language model you choose under Models → Correction. Runs on this computer, on the accelerator the speech model already uses.
store.about.grammar-languagetool: Checks grammar and style with rules, entirely on this computer.
store.about.punctuation-neural: Adds punctuation and capitals to speech models that return plain words.
store.about.translation-offline: Translates what you dictate into another language, without the text leaving this computer.
store.about.denoise-openvino: Removes background noise on the NPU before recognition, leaving the processor free.
store.about.denoise-deepfilternet: High-quality noise removal on the processor, for any computer.
store.localTitle: Installed from a local copy of the published files, checked against the same checksums.
store.fit.npu: Fits this computer: an NPU was found
store.fit.cpu: Fits this computer: no NPU found, so it runs on the processor
store.fit.unknown: Not known until it is tested here
store.failed: The install did not finish: {reason}. Files already checked are kept, so trying again continues it.
store.reason.tls_failed: a secure connection could not be made
store.reason.redirect_refused: the server sent it somewhere Narrivy does not download from
store.reason.integrity_mismatch: a file did not match its checksum, so it was deleted
store.reason.too_large: a file was larger than published
store.reason.disk_write_failed: it could not be saved on this computer
store.reason.downloader_unavailable: the system download tool (curl) is not installed
store.reason.models_directory_unsafe: the install folder can be changed by other users
store.reason.local_source_missing: a file is missing from the developer source
store.olderService: The Narrivy service is older than this app and has no Store. Update it to add accelerators and modules here.
store.empty: The Store lists accelerators and modules only where Narrivy can install them (a development or full installation).
meetings.lead: Record a meeting and get a transcript with each speaker kept apart, in English, Urdu and many more languages. Everything stays on this computer.
meetings.hint: Records your microphone (you and anyone with you) and this computer's sound (people on a call), tells people apart by voice, and writes down what is said as it is said.
meetings.recordingNote: Recording the microphone and this computer's sound
meetings.recordingDetail: Recording. What is said appears below as it is said. When you stop, the whole meeting is gone over again to tell voices apart more reliably.
meetings.liveNote: Written live. Voices are told apart again over the whole meeting when it ends.
meetings.sourcesLegend: Right: heard by your microphone (you, and anyone with you). Left: heard through this computer (people on a call). Select a person to give them a name; give two the same name to join them into one.
meetings.state.speaker: 1 speaker
meetings.error.interrupted: Narrivy stopped before this meeting was transcribed. The recording is safe: choose Transcribe again.
meetings.error.worker: The meeting transcriber is not installed.
meetings.error.model: No speech model for meetings is installed.
meetings.error.other: The meeting could not be transcribed ({code}). The recording is kept; try Transcribe again.
meetings.noSpeech: No speech was found in this recording.
meetings.notes.askPlaceholder: Ask about this meeting, e.g. What did we decide about pricing?
meetings.notes.hint: Written by your assistant model on this computer from the transcript. Long meetings are read in parts first.
meetings.notes.failed: The notes could not be written ({code}). Check the assistant model in Models → Language models.
meetings.notes.empty: No notes yet. Choose Detailed notes for a summary with decisions and action items.
assistant.meetingEmptyNote: Who agreed to what, what is still open, or a summary for someone who missed it. The meeting's notes and transcript go with every question, and stay on this computer.
pipe.noise.shared: Defaults, for every pipeline that does not choose its own:
vocab.title: Your words
vocab.hint: Names, products and terms to recognise. Narrivy gives them to the speech model and corrects near misses (“Narivi” becomes “Narrivy”). Every pipeline uses them.
vocab.replacementsHint: Say one thing, write another: “my email” becomes your address. Applied last.
vocab.unavailable: Not available: the Narrivy service needs updating.
startup.title: Start at login
startup.desc: Narrivy and its service start when you log in, so dictation is ready straight away. When the app opens and the service is not running, it starts it.
startup.descNoService: Narrivy starts when you log in. The Narrivy service is not installed for this user, so it cannot start with it.
startup.hiddenDesc: At login, Narrivy waits in the tray instead of opening its window.
pipe.mic.chooseLive: The microphone Narrivy records, for dictation, meetings and voice training. Every pipeline uses it.
pipe.mic.missing: The chosen microphone is not plugged in: the system default is used until it is back.
learn.title: Add to your words, so it is heard right next time?
hold.title: Press and hold to dictate
hold.desc: Hold one key while you speak, let go to finish. It uses the active pipeline. Your toggle shortcuts keep working as before.
hold.privacy: To see when the key is let go, Narrivy reads your keyboards. It looks only at the key you choose and keeps nothing else, but reading keyboards needs your account in the “input” group, which lets programs you run see every key. Off unless you choose a key.
hold.reading: On: hold the key to dictate.
hold.denied: Narrivy cannot read your keyboards: your account is not in the “input” group. Add it (and log in again), or choose Off.
hold.unavailableService: Not available: the Narrivy service needs updating.
startShortcut.title: Start dictation from any app
startShortcut.tray: You can also start or stop dictation from the Narrivy tray icon.
cancelShortcut.title: Cancel shortcut
cancelShortcut.desc: Stops the dictation in progress without writing anything.
cancelShortcut.name: Cancel dictation
cancelShortcut.manual: This desktop's shortcuts cannot be set from Narrivy: bind “narrivy-cli cancel” in your desktop's keyboard settings.
pipe.mic.soundsHint: A short tone when Narrivy starts listening, and another when it stops. Every pipeline uses it.
history.keep.offNote: New dictations are not kept. What is listed stays until you clear it.
history.clearConfirm: Delete all {count} entries? This cannot be undone.
pipe.refine.numbersLive: “twenty five” is written 25, “five percent” 5%. Zero to nine stay words, and anything ambiguous stays as said. Applies to the Clean pipeline.
pipe.refine.numbersRaw: Applies to the Clean pipeline: this one writes exactly what was heard.
meetings.importHint: Transcribe a recording you already have. You can also drop an audio or video file on this window.
meetings.error.importNoAudio: No sound could be read from that file. Check it plays, or try another format.
meetings.error.importTimeout: Reading that file took too long (over 30 minutes) and was stopped.
pipe.deliver.methodLive: Paste is quick, and fine with long text and Urdu. Typing works where pasting is blocked. If neither reaches the app, the text is kept in the Inbox. Every pipeline uses it.
pipe.deliver.keyboardHint: Paste (uinput) presses Shift+Insert on a small virtual keyboard of Narrivy's, for desktops that ignore the paste keys (COSMIC since October 2026). It needs access to /dev/uinput, which Narrivy does not grant itself; without it the text is typed or kept in the Inbox.
pipe.deliver.restoreLive: After pasting, what you had copied is put back.
meetings.processOnStop: Go over recordings when they stop
meetings.processOnStopHint: Off: a stopped recording is kept as heard, with the live transcript, and gone over (transcribed again, screens described) only when you ask. That is quicker and lighter.
meetings.raw: Kept as heard: the live transcript, screens not described yet.
meetings.devices.speaker: Call audio
meetings.devices.recordingCallOnly: Recording call audio from {out} only; the microphone is off.
meetings.devices.willRecordCallOnly: Records call audio from {out} only; the microphone is off.
meetings.devices.recordingMicOnly: Recording {mic} only; call audio is off.
meetings.devices.willRecordMicOnly: Records {mic} only; call audio is off.
meetings.subtitlesHint: Opens the subtitles (.srt) with each person's name. A .vtt copy is in the meeting's files too.
pipe.refine.idle: Free the clean-up model when unused
pipe.refine.idleHint: Unloads the clean-up model after a while without dictation, to free memory. The next dictation loads it again; until it is ready, that dictation gets the basic tidy-up.
voice.strict.relaxedNote: if your own words go missing
pipe.refine.breaksHint: Say “new line” or “new paragraph” to start one. With Type as the delivery method, a line break is the Enter key, which sends the message in many chat apps; Paste is safer.
assistant.attachHint: Add a picture for the assistant to look at (or paste or drop one). Up to 4.
assistant.error.failed: The model could not answer this. If you added a picture, the current model may not see pictures.
assistant.rememberHint: Keep this in the assistant's memory, for later chats. Edit it under Library → Memory.
assistant.steerHint: Stop this reply and continue with your instruction
assistant.steerPlaceholder: Type to steer the reply that is being written…
assistant.voice.title: Voice mode
assistant.voice.stop: Turn voice off (its models stay loaded)
assistant.voice.whenTalking: When you talk while it speaks
assistant.voice.timing: Last answer: first sound after {total} s (transcribing {asr} s, first words {reply} s, voice {voice} s)
assistant.voice.timingHint: Where the time went between the end of your words and the first sound of the answer.
assistant.voice.error.voice_model_missin: No speaking voice is installed for voice mode.
assistant.voice.error.voice_worker_missi: Voice mode is not set up in this Narrivy service.
assistant.voice.error.voice_speech_model: Voice mode needs a Whisper model; install one in Models.
assistant.voice.error.voice_microphone_l: The microphone stopped. Start voice mode again.
assistant.voice.error.incompatible_proto: The Narrivy service is too old for voice mode. Update Narrivy.
assistant.lib.name: Name
assistant.lib.error.assistant_library_ba: Something is missing or not valid. Check the fields and try again.
assistant.lib.error.assistant_library_fu: There are too many of these already. Delete some first.
assistant.lib.memory.title: Memory
assistant.lib.memory.lead: Facts the assistant keeps about you and uses in every chat. Say “remember that …” in a chat, or add them here.
assistant.lib.persona.title: Personas
assistant.lib.persona.lead: Named assistants with their own instructions, such as an Urdu tutor or an email writer. Pick one for a chat above the conversation.
assistant.lib.persona.placeholder: For example: You are a patient Urdu tutor. Correct my sentences gently and explain why.
assistant.lib.project.title: Projects
assistant.lib.project.lead: What you are working on. A chat with a project gets its instructions, and the project folder's ASSISTANT.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or README.md.
assistant.lib.skill.title: Skills
assistant.lib.skill.lead: Instructions the assistant loads only when you ask for them: start a question with /name. This keeps every other question short for the model.
assistant.lib.skill.name: Name (used as /name)
assistant.lib.routine.title: Routines
assistant.lib.routine.lead: Questions the assistant answers on a schedule, such as “every morning, summarise yesterday's meetings”. Results go into the routine's own chat, here only.
assistant.lib.routine.includeMeetings: Include the notes of meetings recorded since it last ran
assistant.lib.settings.title: Settings
assistant.lib.settings.lead: How dictation into the chat box works, and the keyboard shortcuts.
assistant.lib.settings.editFirst: Edit first: the words wait in the box for you to check
assistant.lib.settings.sendAtOnce: Send at once: the question is sent when you stop dictating
assistant.lib.settings.keyTalk: Hold to talk, with push to talk on
meetings.screen.label: Keep what is on screen
meetings.screen.hint: When the meeting starts, choose the screen or window to keep. Pictures are kept only when it changes (a new slide), stay in the meeting's folder, and are described by the assistant's model after the meeting for the notes.
meetings.screen.unavailable: Needs GStreamer's PipeWire plugin: install the gstreamer1.0-pipewire package, then restart the Narrivy service.
meetings.screen.describing: Looking at what was on screen… {part} of {parts}
meetings.screen.notDescribed: Not described yet: the assistant's model looks at the pictures after the transcript.
meetings.screen.error.screen_permission_: The screen was not kept: sharing it was declined.
meetings.screen.error.screen_capture_una: The screen was not kept: GStreamer's PipeWire plugin is missing (gstreamer1.0-pipewire).
meetings.screen.error.screen_portal_fail: The screen was not kept: the screen-sharing request did not work.
meetings.screen.error.screen_stream_fail: Keeping the screen stopped part way.
assistant.toolsHint: Let the assistant use this server's tools in this chat. You approve every call.
assistant.lib.tool.title: Tools
assistant.lib.tool.lead: MCP servers: programs on this computer that give the assistant tools, such as reading files in a folder. Switch them on per chat, above the conversation.
assistant.lib.tool.command: Command (a program name or full path)
assistant.lib.tool.safety: A server runs as you, with your files and network. Add only servers you trust. The assistant asks before every tool call, and nothing runs without your yes.
assistant.loadHint: Load the model now, so the first answer comes without waiting.
assistant.autoUnloadHint: On: the model is unloaded after ten minutes without a question, freeing its memory. Off: it stays loaded until you unload it.
assistant.watch.hint: Share your screen live with the assistant, or record it as a session.
assistant.watch.cancelHint: Stop going over it. What was recorded stays in Meetings.
assistant.watch.error.meeting_already_re: A meeting or screen session is being recorded; stop it first.
meetings.screen.waitingPicture: Waiting for the first picture: it comes as soon as something on this screen changes (moving the pointer is enough).
meetings.screen.choosing: Waiting for you to choose the screens or windows to share…
meetings.screen.liveError: The screen is not being shared ({code}).
assistant.webHint: Let the assistant search the web and read pages for this chat, without asking. Every step shows in Activity.
assistant.computerHint: Let the assistant use your files, run commands and open things in this chat.
assistant.activity.title: Activity
assistant.live.partial: Being said now: final when the sentence ends
assistant.live.stopHint: Stop sharing and save it as a session
assistant.thinking.label: Thinking
assistant.thinking.hint: How much the assistant thinks before answering in this chat
assistant.thinking.deepHint: Works it through step by step (slower)
assistant.lib.web.title: Web research
assistant.lib.web.lead: Where the assistant searches when Web research is on in a chat. Pages it reads are fetched from this computer; only public sites, never your local network.
assistant.lib.web.engine.auto: The best available (Brave, your SearXNG, DuckDuckGo, then Wikipedia)
assistant.lib.web.keySaved: A key is saved in your keyring
assistant.lib.web.braveHint: Brave's free plan (api-dashboard.search.brave.com) gives about 2,000 searches a month, and is the most reliable. The key is kept in your desktop keyring, not in Narrivy's files.
assistant.lib.web.error.keyring_locked: Your keyring is locked. Unlock it (log in again, or open Passwords and Keys) and try again.
assistant.lib.web.error.keyring_unavaila: No keyring is available to keep the key.
assistant.noChatsFound: No chat has that in its title.
assistant.abilitiesHint: What the assistant may use in this chat: the web, this computer, tool servers.
meetings.work.stopHint: Stop going over this meeting. What is done so far is kept.
meetings.error.stopped: Stopped before it was transcribed. Transcribe it again to go on.
assistant.screen.hint: Share your screen live with the assistant, or record it to give to a chat later.
assistant.screen.shareExplain: This chat sees your screen as you ask, by voice or typing, and hears what is said. When you stop, it is saved as a session you can give to any chat.
assistant.screen.recordExplain: Records the screen and the sound without a chat looking. When you stop, it is saved as a session you can give to any chat.
assistant.screen.starting: Starting… choose the screens or windows
assistant.screen.sharing: Sharing your screen with this chat · {time}
assistant.screen.saved: Session saved. Give it to a chat now, or later from + in any chat (it is also in Meetings).
assistant.screen.shareNote: Ask about what is on screen now: each question carries a picture of it, and what was said so far.
assistant.access.label: How the computer is used
assistant.access.askHint: Asks before it changes or runs anything.
assistant.notice.loaded: The assistant model is loaded on the {device}.
assistant.notice.unloaded: The assistant model was unloaded; its memory is free.
assistant.screen.shareSoundExplain: This chat reads a live transcript of what you hear (a podcast, a call) as you ask. No screen is shared. When you stop, it is saved as a session.
assistant.screen.recordSoundExplain: Records and transcribes the sound without a chat following along. When you stop, it is saved as a session you can give to any chat.
assistant.screen.listenNote: Ask about what is being said: each question carries the transcript so far.
assistant.screen.nothing: Choose the computer sound or your microphone to transcribe.
sources.screenHint: Keep what is on screen. The first time, choose which screen; after that it is reused for this session.
sources.soundHint: Record and transcribe the computer's sound. While off, it is not heard or kept, and times stay in step.
assistant.live.title: Live
assistant.live.nothingYet: Listening… words appear here about 20 seconds after they are said.
assistant.live.allOff: Mic, sound and screen are all off. Switch any on below.
assistant.live.startTranscript: Share what you hear with this chat as a live transcript
assistant.live.startScreen: Share your screen with this chat live
strip.speechAlways: Kept loaded for dictation and transcripts.
strip.assistantSwitchHint: Load or unload the assistant's language model ({name}).
assistant.voice.urduHint: Replies written in Urdu are spoken with the Urdu voice, automatically. Fasih is the only Urdu voice installed.
assistant.voice.offHint: Turn voice off; its models stay loaded, so turning it on again is instant
assistant.voice.unloadHint: Free the memory the voice models use. Loading them again takes a few seconds.
strip.voiceSwitchHint: Load or unload the voice models (speech recognition and speaking voices). Turning voice on and off in a chat keeps them loaded.
assistant.screen.recordHint: Record the screen and its sound as a session, transcribed and described, to give to a chat later
assistant.screen.recordLead: Kept as a session: transcribed, with what was on screen described, to give to a chat when you want. To share live with this chat instead, use Screen and Transcript below the message box.
assistant.live.button.microphoneHint: Your microphone, transcribed: through the echo canceller and noise removal, so the computer's sound is not taken for you. Your trained voice is named You.
assistant.live.button.microphoneStart: Share what you say with this chat as a live transcript
assistant.live.button.soundHint: The computer's sound (a video, a call, a podcast), transcribed
assistant.live.button.soundStart: Share what the computer plays with this chat as a live transcript
assistant.live.button.screenHint: What is on screen: the first time, choose which screen; after that it is reused
assistant.live.button.screenStart: Share your screen with this chat live
assistant.live.paused: The microphone and the sound are off; switch either on to transcribe.
assistant.saved.title: Saved session
assistant.sessions.title: Saved sessions
assistant.saved.working: Going over it: transcribing and describing the screens… {percent}%
assistant.saved.failed: It could not be gone over ({code}).
assistant.saved.ready: Ready to give to a chat.
assistant.saved.raw: Saved as heard: the sound, the live transcript and the screens. Given to a chat, it is gone over (fully transcribed, its screens described).
assistant.saved.waitHint: Ready once it has been gone over
sources.microphoneHint: Record and transcribe your microphone, through the echo canceller. While off, it is not heard or kept.
assistant.folder.title: Working folder
assistant.folder.chooseDefault: Choose a default for all chats
